turns.assessment: The fault is localized to channel och157 before its S08 receiver: estimated OSNR fell and pre-FEC BER rose at S08, followed by a large channel-power and OSNR reduction on the S23→S08 input. The S23 monitor on the incoming S13→S23 degree and the S23→S08 amplifier telemetry saw no change, while other services/channels remained healthy. This strongly indicates channel-specific attenuation in the S23 ROADM WSS rather than a span, amplifier, or receiver fault.

proposals.rationale: A WSS attenuation drift at S23 on och157 explains the downstream 5.87-level channel-power loss, OSNR degradation, and BER increase. It also fits the unchanged upstream S23 input monitor, unchanged aggregate amplifier telemetry, and absence of degradation on other channels.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment

clarify.assessment: The degradation is introduced at S23 after the unchanged input from S13 and before the affected S23→S08 channel monitor. That identifies the S23 WSS channel on the S08-facing OMS, channel 27.

llm_alone.decision: commit after choosing one of 4 locations
